Working for a company where the Student also holds a statutory role, such as a director, counts as engaging in business activity.

claims.reason: Passage 92 says students allowed to work must not be self-employed or engage in business activity, with the only exception being a pending, endorsed Innovator Founder application.
Passage 94 lists setting up a business as a sole trader that is trading or establishing a trading presence as business activity.
Passage 94 lists working for a company where the student holds a statutory role, such as director, as business activity.
Passage 94 lists being employed by a company in which the student holds shares of 10% or more as business activity.

points.point: A Student visa can be used for a part-time course leading to a qualification that is above degree level (RQF level 7 or above).
No work is allowed on a part-time course at postgraduate degree level.
You can only study with a Graduate visa if your chosen course is not eligible for a Student visa.

claims.reason: The passage says part-time study requires a course above degree level at a higher education provider with a track record of compliance.
The caseworker passage says part-time students have no entitlement to work or bring dependants, and the sponsor table says no work is allowed.
The sponsor table gives 20 hours per week during term-time and full-time during vacations for full-time courses at degree level or above with a compliant provider.
The Graduate visa passage states this almost word for word.
The Graduate visa passage lists 'work in most jobs' among the things you can do.
The passage states a Graduate visa lasts 18 months if you apply on or after 1 January 2027.
The passage states you cannot extend a Graduate visa but may be able to switch to a Skilled Worker visa.
The passage lists both requirements among the options a Student visa holder must meet one of, though the claim leaves out the third, PhD option.

points.point: Your university, as your Student sponsor, must report to the Home Office that you are finishing early with the lower-level qualification (the bachelor's degree).
The Home Office will normally cancel (cut short) your Student permission, so that it ends in line with the new, earlier end date of your studies and not on its original date.
To switch from a Student visa to a Skilled Worker visa, you must have completed the course you were sponsored to study, or your job start date must be after your course has finished.
Leaving an integrated master's programme with the lower-level qualification (the bachelor's degree) still counts as completing your course for the switch to a Skilled Worker visa.

claims.reason: The Student guidance passage states that leaving an integrated master's with the lower qualification is deemed successful completion of the CAS course.
SUI 32.1(b) in the cited passage states exactly this cancellation ground.
The cited passage states that caseworkers should normally leave the same wrap-up period after the new course end date when a student completes the course early.
The Skilled Worker switch page lists these three alternative requirements for people on a Student visa.
The cited passage lists the job eligibility and English requirements and the travel restriction until a decision is made.
